integrity: Every connected labeled graph through five vertices is generated directly. Connectivity is checked independently in two ways; strict-majority cascade closure is computed independently by synchronous rounds and by an incremental queue method; and the complete first failure set is canonicalized under all vertex permutations.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns connected finite simple undirected graphs through five vertices, strict-majority progressive diffusion, and a seed budget of exactly two. It does not address larger graphs, other thresholds, other budgets, weighted or directed networks, or activation time.
title: The house graph is the unique first high-degree seeding failure under strict-majority diffusion
